chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from 'Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, who said:
Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام said: "Whoever causes harm to anything belonging to the path of the Muslims is liable for it."

key_terms.ضَامِنٌ: legally liable or responsible for compensation
key_terms.طَرِيقِ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ: the public path or roadway used by Muslims

ai.seo_question: Is a person liable if he causes harm on a public road used by Muslims?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal principle of liability for causing harm in public pathways used by Muslims. It emphasizes protection of public rights and establishes that one who damages or creates harm in such a space is responsible for the consequences.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5346 - Al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from Ali ibn Al-Numan, who narrated from Abu Al-Sabbah Al-Kinani, who narrates that Abu Abdullah (as) said:
"Whoever causes harm to any part of the path of the Muslims is liable for it."
